stem.text: The juice of one lemon reacts completely with $120\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $0.50\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium carbonate solution.
The formula of citric acid is $\text{HOOCCH}_2\text{C(OH)(COOH)CH}_2\text{COOH}$.
No sodium carbonate is left unreacted.
What is the amount of citric acid in one lemon assuming that it is the only acid in the sample?
